name: Phase 1: Measure and make
description: Make useful objects and readable records from real measurements.

name: Phase 2: Lay out and estimate
description: Turn dimensions into layouts, material quantities, and defensible quotes.

name: Phase 3: Support and strengthen
description: Build and compare paper structures using controlled tests.

name: Phase 4: Route and move
description: Coordinate routes using level references, slope, depth, and flow.

name: Phase 5: Heat and electrical systems
description: Investigate thermal performance and low-voltage circuits.

name: Phase 6: Plan a school improvement
description: Deliver a surveyed, calculated, tested proposal for a real user.
